{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the revenue column for formatting issues
print("First 5 values of revenue:")
print(data['revenue'].head())

# Check for thousands separators and non-numeric characters
print("\nUnique values in revenue (first 10):")
print(data['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check for any non-numeric entries (after stripping commas)
print("\nAny non-numeric entries in revenue after stripping?")
print(data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.isnumeric().all())

# Check for the sentinel values mentioned in the documentation
print("\nCount of sentinel revenue values (999999.99):")
print((data['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())"}
